messages:
Jane L.: :rotating_light: Heads up — we're seeing a spike of 502/504 and timeout errors hitting /v1/generate in hosted us-west1. Multiple customer escalations. 5xx ~15% over last 5m. Anyone available for a quick war-room?

Sam (oncall): I'm here, joining. Pinging Mike SRE and Alex from support. Starting quick triage — pulling logs and LB metrics.

Mike SRE: oncall — looking now. Initial logs show `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)` from runtime pods. P50 ok, tail latency and error rate spike. Suspect OOMs or kernel-level resets on runtime.

Alex (support): Customers reporting: `502 Bad Gateway` and `timeout after 30s`. One sent repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"prompt":"long context...","max_tokens":8192}'` — big max_tokens.

Sam (oncall): throttling long requests for hosted tier temporarily, and enabling fallback routing to smaller model variant for critical tenants. Applying routing change now.

DeployBot: Deploy event: rollback runtime image v2026.03.10 -> v2026.03.08 initiated by Sam (oncall).

Mike SRE: grabbing runtime pod logs — snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T18:34:12Z] runtime-078 ERROR request_handler: upstream closed connection (status=502) trace_id=tx-9f3a
[2026-03-15T18:34:13Z] gpu-12 ERROR allocator: OOM when allocating 1024MB
[2026-03-15T18:34:13Z] runtime-078 WARN kvcache: kv cache size exceeded, evicting
```

Mike SRE: pattern shows KV-cache blowup with long-sequence requests after recent kernel/driver update on that node pool. Restarting affected runtime nodes in us-west1.

Sam (oncall): restarted pool — immediate drop in 5xx from ~15% -> ~3% within 8m. Still seeing elevated 95/99 latency for requests with very long max_tokens. Keeping throttles in place for non-SLAs.

Alex (support): leaving a quick customer note: "We're investigating increased errors and have enabled fallbacks; if you continue to see errors, please share request ids." Adding customers to priority list. :thumbsup:

Emily (PM): good mitigation. We need a postmortem + customer comms. We'll capture timeline, root cause, and action items. Assign owners now.

Sam (oncall): action items from war room (first pass):
- Sam (oncall): finalize rollout of throttle/fallback policy for hosted by EOD 2026-03-16.
- Mike SRE: reproduce locally (stress test with long sequences), confirm OOM trigger, produce root-cause writeup (due 2026-03-19).
- Alex (support): follow up with impacted customers and deliver interim comms (today). Collect repro payloads.
- DevEx (TBD): add client-side guidance for retry/backoff and recommended max_tokens per tier (due 2026-03-22).
- Infra: add OOM & KV-cache saturation alerts and an automated circuit-breaker that falls back to smaller model when per-tenant cache growth exceeds threshold (owner: Mike + Infra team, due 2026-03-20).
- Product (Emily): prioritize model-fallback automation and routing SLOs to avoid manual interventions (planning by 2026-03-29).

OpsRunbookBot: War room checklist update — please confirm when 5xx < 1% for 30m to close.

Sam (oncall): monitoring shows 5xx ~0.9% over last 35m after restarts and rollbacks. Leaving throttles for another 24h.

Emily (PM): I'll create the postmortem doc and notify CS. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INCIDENT-177250 (placeholder).

Mike SRE: follow-up note — kernel/drivers rolled to previous stable; we need a canary plan before next kernel update on runtime pools. Adding canary step to infra runbook.

Alex (support): created customer updates and included recommended workaround (reduce max_tokens, retry with exponential backoff).

Sam (oncall): closing war-room now — continuing to monitor. Will keep the incident open for postmortem and action tracking. :white_check_mark:

Jane L.: great work, thanks everyone. Leaving this thread for postmortem items and owners to update.
